excerpt.zh: 为了确保长期生存，[This.GetSpeciesName]物种需要扩张到[This.Capital.GetName]之外的地方去。建立我们的第一个殖民地，并在外星球的地表上插上[This.GetName]的旗帜。
excerpt.en: The [This.GetSpeciesName] species needs to spread beyond [This.Capital.GetName] to secure its long-term survival. Establish our first colony and plant the banner of the [This.GetName] on the surface of an alien world.
